page.overview:
Who is Greb Besrik?

Greb Besrik was a Mon Calamari slicer from Mon Cala. Besrik worked alongside Shae Vizla and her mercenary team. Sometime after Malgus's escape, Besrik bypassed the Republic security checkpoint on the planet Hoth, which his signature modulation pattern matched the one used to slice into Darth Malgus's cell controls on Carrick Station. Jekiah Ordo provided information that Besrik was on Hoth, and Lana Beniko confirmed that her sources from Carrick Station had identified him as Besrik.

The Alliance Commander and Rass Ordo traveled to Hoth to search for Besrik. They looked for clues at Shai Tenna's pleasure den which a patron told them that Besrik went looking for some top-of-the-line cybernetic enhancement stims. Besrik then went to the wreckage of the Star of Coruscant to meet Gane Klisson, a White Maw Lieutenant. They talked about a deal for the stims, but Klisson told Besrik that the price had gone higher. The Commander and Rass arrived and overheard their conversation. During the fight that followed, Besrik took the opportunity to escape.

After they defeated Klisson, the Commander and Rass found Besrik again as he was trying to use a battle droid to defend himself. The Commander and Rass defeated Besrik and started questioning him. Besrik told them that he still worked for Shae Vizla, but he did not know her current location. He also claimed that Shae and Malgus were always together. Rass then called for someone to pick up Besrik and take him away.

Greb Besrik first appeared in the Galactic Threads storyline released in Game Update 7.8: Pursuit of Ruin, released on December 9, 2025, as part of Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith, the eighth digital expansion to the massively multiplayer online role-playing game Star Wars: The Old Republic.
